Right?! When you watch Carrotman,
courage just weeeeells up inside you!!
Together...

"Carrotman" was a tokusatsu superhero show for kids.
Seeing him rise again and again to confront evil truly struck a chord...!

Even without a formal contract, if I could closely supervise her training,
Biko Pegasus would surely blossom.

A "small" Biko Pegasus standing up against "giant" opponents.
Undaunted, never giving up, filled with courage.

"Full of nutrition! Full of justice!
Carotene Charge, Carrotman!!"

Well, yeah... but that's just 'cause I haven't fully grown yet.
From now on, I'll train hard so I can fight right alongside Carrotman!
Huh, Carrotman?! Really?!

I told her that her courageous stand despite her small stature
truly made her look like a hero!

Ever since that mock race, I found myself even more captivated by Biko Pegasus,
and began stopping by to watch her training whenever I had a chance.

I'll outgrow everyone soon enough,
and once I master dirt, I'll challenge turf someday—

...?
What's up? Why're you quiet... Ah, you wanna watch episode 2 already?!

Remembering that—I felt courage
begin to swell in my own heart as well.
And then that line!! You get it, Trainer?!

...Justice Biko shall now
fight alongside an 'ally'!!

Phew... For my fans' sake, I gotta hurry up
and become a cool Umamusume like 'Carrotman'!

However, that's exactly why... I want to help nurture her strengths.
I've watched her all this time; I'm confident I know where her appeal lies.

How was it, Trainer?!
Episode 1, "Carrotman Is Born: The Envoy of Nutrition and Justice!"!!

Carrotman isn't super overpowered right from the start.
He takes hits, he gets knocked down, he gets pushed to the brink—

Hey, what's with the "small body" thing, though?!
Sure, I might be small right now, but I'm gonna grow way bigger!
Just then, something crosses my mind.

I know I can get her running on the turf course she dreamed of.
And most of all—

I know I'm still small, but...
Can I really catch up? Do you think I can still run on turf, starting now?!

Heheh, awriiiight!!
That means I'm just as cool as Carrotman, right?!

No time to waste, off to the scene of action!!
Meet ya in the trainer's room after school!!
Ready, go! "I'm not done—"

Let's watch the hero I look up to—
"Carrotman," together!!

Whaaat?! Trainer, don't tell me
you don't know "Carrotman"?! This is an emergency...!!

Heheh... thanks, Trainer!!
Let's give it our all together from now on!!

—It's fine, I can still catch up!!
For now, I just gotta run with everything I've got! If I do that, then surely...!

Watching her try to convince herself leaves me at a loss for words.
Even as she is now, Biko Pegasus is already plenty "cool."

Yet... a rookie like me lacks the ability to tackle something
as monumental as an Umamusume's racing career. I don't have the courage—
Yeah! That's what's so great about Carrotman!!

Yeah, yeah, allies... wait, huh?!
Trainer, you're gonna be mine?

Trainer!
You came today too, thanks a bunch!!

—Even so, he always gets back up!!
Even against someone he might not be able to beat, he never runs away!!
How's that?! I'm just getting started, babyyy!!

Woaaah... Carrotmaaan!!
That first transformation gives me chills every time, it's so cooool!!
? What's wrong? You're deep in thought.
What suddenly came to mind was that practice race.

Look, I already put on Episode 2!
Episode 2 is the one where the rival who later becomes his ally shows up—

"—So no matter how many times I fail, ...
I'll fight to the bitter end for justice and everyone's health!!"
